title: Replication Codebase: Continental Trade Specialization Sustains European Aquatic Food Security Beyond Local Ecological Boundaries
description: Complete replication codebase and analytical synthesis matrices for 'Continental Trade Specialization Sustains European Aquatic Food Security Beyond Local Ecological Boundaries' published in Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems. Contains modular Python scripts for data harmonization, econometric trade indices (Balassa RCA, GHM IIT, HHI), gravity network modeling (structural PPML and ML TreeSHAP), food safety hazard modeling, consumer access buffering, ecological harvest displacement, nutrient pricing, extra-EU partner sourcing, and constrained Markowitz-Pareto portfolio optimization.
